questions.text:
1.—Do you have any plans for the weekend, Linda?()
—Sure. I ______ games with my friends.
A. am going to play B. am playing C. play

2. Look! Alice ______ a model plane over there.()
A. makes B. is making C. will make

3. He ______ to invent a flying car.()
A. is B. is going C. will

4.—They are going to ______ a picture book.()
—I think it'll be interesting.
A. reads B. read C. reading

5. Tom is going to ______ TV ______ Sunday.()
A. watching; in B. watch; on C. watch; at

6. What is Alice ______ after lunch?()
A. doing B. going C. going to do

7. Simon looks busy. What is he going to do?()
A. He is doing his homework.
B. He is going to skate.
C. He often does his homework.

8. Linda usually ______ her clothes in the morning, but now she ______ her clothes.
A. washes; is washing B. is washing; washes C. washes; is washing

9. Linda ______ like reading books. But she will ______ more books in the future.
A. doesn't; read B. don't; reading C. doesn't; to read

10. Lucy ______ to school on foot.()
A. go B. goes C. going

11. Ben ______ the mountain at the weekend.()
A. climb B. will climbs C. is going to climb

12. The flowers like ______ and they are ______ in the wind softly.()
A. dance; dancing B. dancing; dancing C. dancing; dance

13. Jill. ______ wear glasses in the future.()
A. won't B. doesn't C. isn't

14. We will go to Beijing ______ week.()
A. last B. after C. next

15. I won't give you any ice creams ______ you get well.()
A. until B. but C. to
16. Miss Spring never ______ (come) late again.
17. My sister sometimes ______ (watch) TV in the evening.
18. He is ______ (knock) down the house because he plans to build a new one.
19. There ______ (be) many great ______ (invent) in the world.

20.—I have a ______ (head) now.
—Have a good rest and you ______ (get) well soon.
